## New in 0.1.12

- **Bundled color themes.** Eleven light palettes and six dark palettes in Settings → Appearance,
  with separate day and night choices when following system dark mode and a temporary
  "Just this time" override.
- **Integrated window title bar.** Workspace columns extend to the top edge under a transparent
  drag strip, with native DirectWrite caption buttons on Windows, centered traffic lights inside
  the macOS sections rail, and client-side decorations on Linux.
- **Calendar sidebar layout and month picker.** The calendar sidebar extends to the full window
  height with a compact mini-calendar (busy-day dots and quick return to today) and multi-select
  All, Tags, and Lists filters. Clicking the month heading opens a 4 × 3 month and year picker.
- **Interactive calendar task marks.** Calendar rows now show clickable checkboxes (including
  checklist lines and Won't Do marks) and page icons for notes, syncing changes immediately with
  open sticky notes.
- **Sticky note taskbar visibility.** Hide sticky note windows from the Windows taskbar in
  Settings → Sticky Note. Open notes now restore on startup without stealing focus from the main
  window.

## Bug fixes

- **View-switch selection and detail sync.** Switching lists, smart lists, tags, or filters
  automatically selects the first visible task and synchronizes the detail panel; filtering
  Completed and Won't Do views keeps the detail panel in sync.
  ([#17](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/17))
- **Cross-window sticky note sync.** Editing task notes, checklist items, or comments in the
  main window or calendar now updates open sticky note editors in place instead of leaving stale
  text buffers.
- **Settings rows and appearance controls.** Restored missing row backgrounds and rounded corners
  in Settings, fixed the selected badge ring on theme swatches, and ensured theme-save errors
  display their warning dialog. ([#16](https://github.com/atabits/fern/issues/16))
- **Sticky note window behavior.** Repeated double-clicks on sticky note title bars reliably
  toggle compact mode, window titles stay in sync after edits, and closing notes cleans up hidden
  taskbar owner handles on Windows.
- **Text, icon, and mini-calendar alignment.** Aligned single-line labels using font cap height
  and pixel snapping, isolated inline icon captions across interactive row controls, and fixed
  the mini-calendar divider and hover toggle tab.
- **Linux AppImage packaging.** Bundled XKB libraries (`libxkbcommon`, `libxkbcommon-x11`,
  `libxcb-xkb`) and the 256 px PNG icon in the AppImage while keeping host libraries prioritized
  for child processes.
- **Standalone Windows ZIP documentation.** Clarified that standalone Windows ZIP archives keep
  data in the standard user profile unless a `.portable` marker file is placed beside `fern.exe`.
